evaluation_context.goal: Produce an excellent, source-faithful learner session while preserving all deterministic correctness, identity, and sequence constraints.
evaluation_context.source_fidelity_goal: Independently verify the hard-gated edited challenger against the supplied source material. Reject unsupported facts, answers, explanations, feedback, or terminology changes; do not edit the artifact.

criteria.factual_fidelity: Every claim and answer is faithful to the supplied source.

sources.input_id: 8. Get started with generative AI and agents in Azure.md
sources.location: sources/8. Get started with generative AI and agents in Azure.md

evidence.statement: All seven keyed answers and explanations match the supplied source examples: marketing writing, customer support, code generation, visual generation, and personalized learning.
Each item specifies a single correct choice, a defined set of correct choices, or an exact accepted fill-in answer; the supplied distractors do not create a competing answer.
Most distractors are credible alternatives from the same source use-case set, though some are broad category mismatches and therefore relatively easy to reject.
The artifact labels errors such as visual-versus-writing, support-versus-coding, and learning-versus-support, and pairs them with better-fit explanations, diagnosing realistic category confusions.

The ordered sequence begins with an analyzing/evaluating item, moves to another advanced item, drops to recall, then alternates between advanced classification and recall; it does not visibly scaffold from foundational identification toward application.
The session uses multiple-choice, select-all, and fill-blank mechanics, but five of seven items are multiple-choice variants and the two fill-blank items use nearly identical construction.

Several prompts repeat the same scenario-and-selection pattern, especially the stems beginning with a workplace role followed by “Which” or “Select all that apply”; the two fill-blank stems are also formulaically parallel.

The creative-director, engineering-lead, support-director, and tutor contexts correspond to credible workplace or learning decisions, although the explicit exclusion clause in the final item is somewhat test-like.
Incorrect-option feedback usually explains the mismatch and names the better use, but correct-answer explanations are brief and generally omit a concrete next step.
The unit metadata states Level 3 and an identify-and-match learning objective, while five of seven items are marked rung 5 with “Analyzing/Evaluating” Bloom levels.
Core terms such as virtual agents, natural language, image and video generation, personalized learning, product descriptions, code snippets, functions, and modules remain consistent with the source.

The seven-item session is source-faithful, answerable, and reasonably varied, but the exact order mixes Level 3 recall with a majority of Level 5 analysis items and provides limited conceptual scaffolding.

critical_defects.summary: Most items are explicitly tagged at rung 5 and Analyzing/Evaluating despite the unit being Level 3 with an identify-and-match objective.

evidence.statement: Five of seven payloads have rung 5 and Blooms level “Analyzing/Evaluating,” while metadata sets the unit title to “What generative AI can do · Level 3” and the SLO to “Identify what generative AI is and match it to common workplace uses.”

largest_gap.summary: The sequence lacks a clear progression from foundational recognition to guided application and retrieval.

evidence.statement: The first two items are advanced classification tasks, the third is recall, and later items alternate between advanced selection and recall rather than increasing complexity coherently.

largest_gap.repair_instruction: Reorder the existing concepts so foundational recognition and exact-term retrieval precede simple matching, then place scenario-based application at the end; align the advanced items to the stated Level 3 target or replace them with lower-complexity variants.

result.concise_summary: The artifact is highly source-faithful and answerable with useful misconception labels, but its exact sequence is uneven and mostly tagged above the stated Level 3 objective. No approved references were supplied, so confidence is reduced.

history.stop_evidence: Critic requested human review or confidence was below threshold.
